messages:
sam_prod: Quick announce — launching a new Dedicated pool backed by A800X GPUs in us-west-3 (edge cluster) next week. Initial capacity for customers on Dedicated and Dedicated+Reserved.

elaine_ops: awesome — rough GA date?

marco_infra: Targeting 2026-04-01 for internal GA, public reservations open 2026-04-05. Initial footprint: 6 shards (8 A800X per shard) with burst spike gear up to 10 shards for short periods.

sam_prod: Two important policy notes: 1) burst capacity will be billed at 1.25x compute units for the burst window, 2) this pool will not offer preemptible slots to preserve latency SLAs.

june_sales: Can customers reserve these? Any special ARR discounts?

sam_prod: Yes — standard Reserved capacity contracts apply. Intro pricing guidance: 18% off monthly for 6-month commit, 28% off for 12-month. We'll publish a pricing FAQ shortly.

marco_infra: Ops details (for infra/eng): rollout plan snippet:

```
- 2026-03-30: infra tests & canary deploy (internal)
- 2026-04-01: internal GA + SRE soak
- 2026-04-05: reservations open to customers
- 2026-04-10: open for on-demand routing
```

marco_infra: Notes: KV-cache priming across zones will be staggered to avoid thundering herd. If you're integrating model variants, pin to the a800x-v1 image.

elaine_ops: Is there any change to fallback behavior if us-west-3 capacity is exhausted?

sam_prod: Yes — smart routing will prefer region pinning but will fall back to compatible A800X pools in us-west-2 if customer allows cross-region routing. Fallback respects privacy/tier flags.

june_sales: Heads-up for AE teams: don't promise burst guarantees until we publish the formal SLA. Use internal FAQ v1 for now.

ceo_ash: Thanks — mark for exec review of external statement. Confirmed no public press until legal signs off.

opsbot: deploy-notify: dedicated-pool/a800x/us-west-3 created by @marco_infra at 2213460320 :white_check_mark:

sam_prod: I'll drop the doc links and pricing spreadsheet in #eng-platform and #sales later today. If you need early access for demos ping @sam_prod and @marco_infra.

elaine_ops: pinged for oncall runbook updates. Will add escalation playbook.

marco_infra: FYI — we'll surface a short migration guide for customers moving from A700-class pools; expect minor config diffs (tensor cores enabled by default).

june_sales: thx. pls include sample TCO calc for typical gen-chat workloads.

sam_prod: noted — will attach to the pricing FAQ.

elaine_ops: :thumbsup: Great work team, looking forward to the safety/soak reports next week.
